race.comment: ONYSPEED (4) lifted sharply from first to second up effort in going under by a nose at Orange. This is the same sort of race and she should be getting a very similar run. Won't be getting a long way off them. QUASIMOTO (5) brings in winning form. He loves to race right on the speed so will be crossing over quickly. Just has to run this distance right out. STREET SWAGGER (7) was only beaten a small margin when last racing. Does go best if the track is soft but hard to knock his form. I'M SCARLETT (8) has had a few chances but finds a lovely gate to do no work with a lighter weight.
